name: Pilomyxoid Astrocytoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System (2021)

criteria.description: Presence of monomorphous bipolar cells in a myxoid background with angiocentric arrangement
MRI showing a well-circumscribed, predominantly suprasellar or hypothalamic mass with cystic and solid components
Absence of BRAF-KIAA1549 fusion typical of pilocytic astrocytoma; possible presence of other MAPK pathway alterations

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of characteristic pilomyxoid features with supportive imaging findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires neuropathological examination; molecular testing may aid in differentiation from pilocytic astrocytoma

pathognomonic.notes: Includes disturbances in appetite, temperature regulation, and sleep

common.symptomName: Headache due to increased intracranial pressure
searchTerms: head pain from increased intracranial pressure

common.symptomName: Nausea and vomiting secondary to raised intracranial pressure
searchTerms: vomiting caused by increased intracranial pressure

common.symptomName: Endocrine abnormalities such as precocious puberty
searchTerms: hormone problems causing early sexual development

laboratory: Endocrine hormone panel abnormalities (e.g., altered cortisol, thyroid hormones)
imaging: MRI showing well-circumscribed suprasellar/hypothalamic mass with cystic and solid components
T2 hyperintensity with homogeneous or heterogeneous enhancement on contrast MRI
other: Histopathology demonstrating monomorphous bipolar cells in myxoid background with angiocentric pattern

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of biphasic pattern with Rosenthal fibers
Commonly arises in ventricles or spinal cord

redFlags: Signs of increased intracranial pressure (e.g., papilledema)
New onset seizures in young child
references: Louis DN, et al. WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th Edition, 2021.
Packer RJ, et al. Pilomyxoid astrocytoma: a review. J Neurooncol. 2010.
